faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IPRCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IPRCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies: 5 CGM (Projects)/E8, 1 CGM (Electrical)/E8, 1 CGM (S&T)/E8, 1 CGM (Mechanical)/E8.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IPRCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-II (for absorption) and Annexure-III (for deputation) of this notice) and send it to Chief General Manager (HR), Indian Port Rail & Ropeway Corporation Ltd (IPRCL), 4th Floor, Nirman Bhavan, Mumbai Port Trust Building, M.P. Road, Mazgaon (E), Mumbai- 400010, by post / courier or dropped personally, to reach by 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 57 years (as on 4 December 2026). Relaxation: Employees presently working on rolls of IPRCL Over and above the upper age limit to the extent of their service period rendered in IPRCL.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: On Absorption: IDA Scale of pay: Rs.120000-280000 + Applicable Allowances + PRP; On Deputation: Parent Pay & Allowances + Deputation Duty Allowance + Other Allowances for CGM (Projects)/E8, On Absorption: IDA Scale of pay: Rs.120000-280000 + Applicable Allowances + PRP; On Deputation: Parent Pay & Allowances + Deputation Duty Allowance + Other Allowances for CGM (Electrical)/E8, On Absorption: IDA Scale of pay: Rs.120000-280000 + Applicable Allowances + PRP; On Deputation: Parent Pay & Allowances + Deputation Duty Allowance + Other Allowances for CGM (S&T)/E8, On Absorption: IDA Scale of pay: Rs.120000-280000 + Applicable Allowances + PRP; On Deputation: Parent Pay & Allowances + Deputation Duty Allowance + Other Allowances for CGM (Mechanical)/E8.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Full time Degree in Engineering in the discipline prescribed for each post (Civil/Electrical/Mechanical/Electronics & Communication for CGM Projects; Electrical; Electronics group; Mechanical). Not applicable on deputation. Required experience: Execution of Infrastructure Projects. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applications are invited from Indian citizens. Applicant should be physically and medically fit; selected candidate must undergo medical examination as per corporation's policy. Serving Railway, Govt., Central PSU, Port or JV employees must apply through proper channel and submit NOC at the interview. Serving Railway, Govt., Central PSU, Port or JV employees must send photocopies of last 05 years APARs with the application.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Canvassing in any form will disqualify a candidate.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting based on eligibility/experience in the relevant field (ratio 1:5 when there are 05 or more eligible candidates per vacancy). Personal Interview. Personal Interview may be held at the Corporate Office of IPRCL, through V.C. or at any other location at IPRCL's discretion. With 05 or more eligible candidates per vacancy, IPRCL may shortlist in the ratio of 1:5 based on eligibility/experience.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: On Absorption OR On Deputation for 03 years extendable further as per rules. Subject to extension of exemption from rule of immediate absorption beyond 01.11.2028 by Ministry/DPE. Three-month advance notice required before seeking resignation.
